name: Global Multi-Tenant Video Streaming & Edge CDN Architecture
objective: Design an edge-accelerated, multi-tier video delivery network capable of serving 50,000,000 concurrent global video streams (4K HDR, HLS, MPEG-DASH, Low-Latency CMAF) with sub-second startup times and 99.999% availability.
constraints: Sub-1-second initial video playback startup time across 120+ global Points of Presence (PoPs)
Origin offload factor of >= 98.5% under unexpected viral traffic spikes
Hardware-accelerated live video transcoding pipeline scaling to 5,000 concurrent live broadcasts
Multi-DRM protection (Apple FairPlay, Google Widevine, Microsoft PlayReady) with tokenized stream playback URLs
Zero-buffer bandwidth adaptation using client-side ABR (Adaptive Bitrate) feedback algorithms

components.name: Global Anycast Edge Cache Fleet
components.technology: OpenResty / Varnish / Cloudflare Workers / BGP Anycast
components.responsibility: Terminates TLS 1.3 / HTTP/3 connections at the nearest metropolitan PoP, serves cached video segments (.m4s, .ts), and enforces signed URL token validation.

components.name: Hierarchical Origin Shield Cluster
components.technology: Envoy Proxy / Redis Cache Mesh on Bare Metal
components.responsibility: Collapses redundant cache misses across edge PoPs into single origin requests, eliminating thundering-herd load on master media storage.

components.name: Distributed GPU Transcoding Pipeline
components.responsibility: Encodes live RTMP/SRT broadcast feeds into adaptive bitrate ladders (1080p, 720p, 480p, 360p) in H.264, HEVC, and AV1 formats.

components.name: Universal Key & DRM Licensing Server
components.responsibility: Issues hardware-bound FairPlay and Widevine cryptographic licenses to authenticated subscriber client players.

components.name: Real-Time Quality of Experience (QoE) Telemetry Pipeline
components.responsibility: Aggregates player buffering ratios, bitrate switching events, and CDN egress health metrics to drive automated traffic rerouting.

security_threats: SPOOFING: Forged stream tokens bypassing subscription paywalls to restream video
TAMPERING: Man-in-the-middle injection of unauthorized ads into HLS media manifests
DENIAL_OF_SERVICE: DDoS floods targeting origin shield servers to knock out live broadcasts
